settings.themeDesc: Applies to the control panel and menus. Cards on the line always look like paper.
settings.languageDesc: Add a language by dropping a JSON file into the translations folder (see About).
settings.cardSizeDesc: How big screenshots and notes are on the line.
settings.autoHideDesc: Cards slide up until only their edges show. Move the pointer to the top of the screen to bring them back.
settings.keepDesc: After this, discarded screenshots are deleted from disk.
settings.startupDesc: Clothesline starts quietly in the notification area when you sign in.
settings.autoUpdateDesc: Download, check and install new versions when you're not using Clothesline
settings.logsDesc: Attach these when you report a problem.

shortcut.hangWindow: Hang a live window on the line

about.updatesDesc: Check for a newer Clothesline release. Nothing downloads or installs until you choose it.
about.readyToInstall: {0} is ready and installs when you're away
update.failed: Couldn't update Clothesline. Download it from the release page.
about.tagline: Clothesline hangs your screenshots, notes and live app windows on a line across the top of the screen, so the things you need for the next few minutes stay in sight without cluttering your desktop.
about.issue: Report a problem or suggest an idea
about.translateDesc: Copy en.json from the repository, translate the values, save it here under your language code (for example de.json) and restart Clothesline.
about.creditsText: Forked from Jemur by Revan Apriyandi (github.com/revanapriyandi/jemur), itself inspired by Tendedero, a macOS app by @alejandr0bujan. Clothesline adds live-window hanging and Simplified Chinese; both original projects are MIT-licensed.
about.license: Released under the MIT License. Built with .NET and WPF.
